title: metrosideros polymorpha var. fauriei
intro: Metrosideros polymorpha var. fauriei, commonly known as the Tahina or Scarlet Flower, is a plant species native to Tahiti and other islands in French Polynesia. This plant is traditionally used in Polynesian medicine to treat various health conditions, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Metrosideros polymorpha var. fauriei include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of respiratory and gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
